children: The property comprises 287 guestrooms, restaurants, banquet and meeting venues, spa and recreational facilities

Juniper Hotels Limited has announced the proposed acquisition of Novotel Imagicaa from Imagicaaworld Entertainment Limited for an aggregate consideration of rupee 248 crore, at approximately rupee 86 lakh per key, subject to the terms and conditions of the definitive agreements. The proposed acquisition will add a 287-key operating hotel to Juniper’s portfolio and strengthen its presence in the Mumbai-Pune corridor.

Spread across approximately 11 acres in Khopoli, Maharashtra, Novotel Imagicaa is strategically located near the economic centres of Mumbai and Pune, with the airport accessible within a two-hour drive. The hotel is adjacent to the Imagicaa Theme Park and Water Park and spans a built-up area of approximately 2,80,000 sq. ft.

The property comprises 287 guestrooms, restaurants, banquet and meeting venues, spa and recreational facilities. It has established a presence across leisure and social segments, positioning it as a family holiday destination.

The acquisition aligns with Juniper’s long-term objective of building a portfolio of large, high-quality hotels across key business and leisure destinations. As an established operating asset, Novotel Imagicaa is expected to generate stable cash flows from day one, without the development lead time associated with a greenfield project.

The property will also provide Juniper with a presence across leisure, social and MICE segments in the Mumbai-Pune corridor. The company sees potential to add incremental banqueting and ballroom capacity, supported by demand from the adjacent Imagicaa parks. Juniper also intends to explore the opportunity to rebrand the hotel into the upper-upscale segment and drive higher revenue over the long term.
The asset offers diversified demand generators across leisure, social, MICE and weekend travel, while providing an opportunity for Juniper to leverage its asset management and hospitality expertise.

“At Juniper, our growth journey has always been guided by a simple principle: grow with purpose and create value for the long term. Novotel Imagicaa represents the kind of asset we look for. It is an established hospitality property with scale, a strong destination proposition, and multiple demand generators.

Our upcoming developments will significantly expand the company’s scale. We remain focused on owning the ‘Right Assets’ in the right markets, large, capable of generating diversified revenue streams across rooms, F&B, MICE, serviced apartments, commercial spaces and other hospitality offerings. We intend to pursue this growth with capital discipline, strong internal cash generation and a healthy balance sheet, and selectively evaluate acquisition opportunities where we see a compelling strategic fit.”
Arun Kumar Saraf, Chairman & Managing Director, Juniper Hotels Limited, said the company will continue to focus on assets that offer strategic fit and opportunities for long-term value creation.

Completion of the acquisition remains subject to the execution of definitive agreements, satisfaction of customary closing conditions and receipt of required statutory, regulatory and other approvals.
